about: Made-up settings for scripts/test-route-snapshot.js's import of server.js, and what that import may still start. The runner adds PATH, LOGISX_IMPORT_ONLY=1, and DATABASE_PATH, TMPDIR and HOME inside a fresh scratch folder; nothing else from the parent environment reaches the import. Kept here, not in the runner, because these names are server.js declarations, and a runner whose text names one is picked by the pre-push hook only when that declaration changes (scripts/lib/test-selection.js).

importAllowlist.why: The session store always starts its hourly expired-session sweep: it reads `clear || true`, so `clear: !REPLICA` cannot turn it off. Library internal.
Each rate limiter's memory store starts an unref'd expiry timer when the limiter is built at module level. Library internal.
The unref'd live-update socket sweep. Gated by stage 1b, after #570 (scripts/test-session-sockets.js pins this line).
The database-export temp-file sweep reads the temp folder at import. Gated by stage 1b, after #585.
